body.objective: Test the smallest action-derived enlargement capable of repairing both surviving Berger observer defects: a direct temporal Maxwell-potential--rod Hessian and the corresponding quartic Diff-BV covariance descendant reaching the spatial ghost-antifield row.
body.stop_condition: When pulled, import BERGER_AUXILIARY_DIFF_BV_SCALAR_ORBIT_REPAIR and its exact source-labelled +g0 h0 arity-two and -4 g0 h0 arity-three witnesses from commit fbc422cfa by content hash. Declare a complete local support-preserving Diff x Weyl x Maxwell x Berger-U(1) scalar-density ansatz whose Hessian can reach tau_star <- (e0 e1 A_0,K0_01), including the full covariance orbit and every quartic descendant that can reach c_spatial_star_1 <- (e0 e0 e2 A_0,chi,K0_12). Derive q1, q2 and q3 from one extended action and replay nilpotency, odd cyclicity, arity-two and arity-three master identities, Maxwell invariance, K_Berger compatibility and both source-isolation mutations. Either construct the complete nonempty admissible coefficient locus and classify its moduli, or prove that every member of the declared action module retains an exact defect and identify the next missing representation. Only after every action gate passes may the item replay clocks, rods, emitter, receiver, memory or detector response. Land exact payload and result certificates, an independent variation/master-identity verifier, representation-removal and coefficient mutations, an atlas update and a Paper 09 lifecycle disposition.
body.current_gate: complete action-derived temporal A--K Hessian and quartic Diff-covariance repair of the two surviving Berger observer master defects
body.forbid: no hand-added q2 or q3 cancellation term without one common local action; no selected coefficient subfamily called complete; no temporal A--K monomial without its full Diff, Weyl, Maxwell and Berger-U(1) orbit; no q3 imported independently of q1 and q2; no quotient by field redefinition before the master identities hold; no detector, redshift, memory, recoil, raw-D, branch, particle, positivity, phenomenology, scattering or quantum promotion from a failed action gate
activates: a nonempty same-action nonlinear observer completion suitable for quartic calibration and relational redshift
or a stronger action-module-complete obstruction with the next missing representation identified
body.resource_hint: IMMEDIATE OBSERVER SUCCESSOR after the auxiliary scalar-orbit obstruction. The item name sorts before the existing quartic calibration reserve. Build the full action module around the two certified source-labelled witnesses rather than adding isolated cancellation columns.
notes: The auxiliary scalar orbit is uniquely normalized but has no A--K Hessian and cannot change either surviving witness.
The arity-two source fixes the required temporal Hessian representation; the arity-three source requires its quartic Diff-covariance descendant. Both must come from the same local action.
The item is input-pinned rather than dependency-gated so the terminal OBSTRUCTED predecessor remains consumable without stranding the resident Observer stream.
